## Summary

Resolved persistent pod evictions on worker-node-7 caused by DiskPressure due to /var/lib/containerd reaching 94% capacity. The root cause was a misconfigured kubelet setting where imageGCHighThresholdPercent was raised to 95%, preventing automatic garbage collection. Fixed the issue by revering the threshold to 80 in the node-config DaemonSet, pruning unused images via crictl, and restarting the kubelet service.

- node-config DaemonSet
